jobs.occupation: ERP Programme Planning Specialist – Global ERP Transformation
jobs.description:
ERP Programme Planning Specialist – Global ERP Transformation
Are you an experienced ERP Programme Planning Specialist who enjoys bringing structure, clarity and control to complex international transformation programmes? Do you thrive in an environment where planning, resource management and collaboration are essential to successful delivery?
We are currently looking for an experienced ERP Programme Planning Specialist for an exciting consulting assignment with one of our clients, a leading international company within the industrial sector, based in Lund, Sweden.
This is an opportunity to play an important role in a large-scale global ERP transformation programme, working closely with international teams, project managers and senior stakeholders.
About the role
As an ERP Programme Planning Specialist, you will be part of a Transformation Management Office (TMO), supporting the planning and coordination of multiple ERP rollout projects.
Your main focus will be to create and maintain a clear, integrated overview of programme timelines, milestones, resources and risks, ensuring that programme leadership has the information needed to make informed decisions.
The role combines strategic programme planning with hands-on coordination, analysis and continuous improvement.
Your main responsibilities
Develop and maintain an integrated programme plan across multiple ERP rollout projects.

Coordinate milestones, schedules and dependencies across international teams and workstreams.

Manage resource allocation, capacity planning and forward-looking resource forecasts.

Identify resource bottlenecks, scheduling conflicts and potential delivery risks.

Maintain programme-wide risk registers with clear ownership and escalation procedures.

Monitor programme progress and provide structured reporting to senior stakeholders.

Analyse planning, resource and risk data to support informed decision-making.

Support scenario planning, prioritisation and replanning when programme requirements change.

Collaborate closely with project managers, business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure alignment across the programme.

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for a structured, analytical and proactive professional with solid experience in large-scale ERP implementations, international system rollouts or complex business transformation programmes.
You understand the challenges of coordinating multiple projects, managing dependencies and ensuring that resources are effectively planned and utilised.
You are comfortable working in international environments, communicating with senior stakeholders and translating complex information into clear, actionable insights.
Key skills and experience
Proven experience in programme planning, PMO/TMO or large-scale ERP transformation programmes.

Experience coordinating international ERP implementations or system rollouts.

Strong understanding of integrated programme planning and milestone management.

Practical experience in resource management, capacity planning and forecasting.

Experience identifying and managing risks and dependencies across multiple projects.

Strong analytical skills and experience working with planning and resource data.

Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

Ability to work independently while maintaining a programme-wide perspective.

Excellent communication skills in English.

Nice to have
Experience with SAP or other enterprise ERP platforms.

Background in global transformation programmes within industrial or manufacturing organisations.

Experience with programme planning, reporting or resource management tools.

Experience supporting senior leadership with scenario analysis and decision-making.

About you
You are a solution-oriented and detail-focused professional who enjoys creating structure in complex environments.
You have a proactive mindset, strong communication skills and the ability to bring people together across different functions and geographical locations.
You understand the importance of balancing long-term programme objectives with day-to-day operational priorities and enjoy contributing to successful transformation initiatives.
Assignment details
Location: Lund, Sweden Work arrangement: Hybrid (on-site presence required) Assignment type: Consulting assignment Start date: As soon as possible / By agreement Duration: Until 22 July 2027 Working hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week
Does this sound like you?
We would love to hear from you!
We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
Please submit your application through our application portal, as applications sent directly via email will not be considered.

• Develop our FX Services to be the preferred choice for small and mid-sized corporates, as well as selected large corporate clients.

• Assess and improve the performance of your team members.
• Ensure the continuous development of your team and continue to build a team with high level of team spirit and engagement.
• Align your work and the team’s contribution to the bank’s direction and strategy. 
What is needed in this role:
• Proven leadership experience with a track record of building and developing high-performing teams.

Extensive experience in Foreign Exchange (FX), including FX sales and advisory services for corporate clients.

Proven ability to drive sales growth, business performance and sustainable results.

Strong relationship management skills, with experience engaging senior decision-makers and key stakeholders.

Excellent communication and presentation skills in both Swedish and English.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or equivalent relevant experience.

Ability to lead in line with Swedbank's values: Open, Simple and Caring.

With us, you can experience:
Personal and professional growth through self-leadership and continuous development.

Meaningful work that positively impacts our workplace, our customers, and society.

An open and collaborative culture that encourages cross-functional teamwork and provides networking opportunities.

A supportive and inclusive environment that promotes a balanced and sustainable work-life, with flexible working conditions when suitable for the role.

This is our team...
We are a dedicated and successful team with many experienced professionals. We work with a proactive sales responsibility towards corporate and institutional clients across both Swedbank and the Savings Banks, where we offer products based on the customers' needs. Our work is very much characterized by an analytical way of working to help customers make informed decisions. Internally, we collaborate closely with Client Executives and other product specialists, including Trade Finance and Cash Management, to grow the FX business and deliver the best possible client offering. Together, we work to maximize customer value every day through close collaboration, strong client engagement and a shared commitment to excellence. In our team we value teamwork and we expect you to be a collaborative and engaged team player!
As leaders, we trust our people and delegate responsibility, we strive to build a team with an open, positive and transparent environment, where everyone can grow and have the possibility to learn from each other." Cornelia Reifeldt, your future manager.

jobs.occupation: Future Talent - Development Engineer Packaging Material
jobs.description:
At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. 
And we need people like you to make it happen.
We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.
Job Summary
 Start your career development and become Tetra Pak’s next Future Talent! We are looking for highly motivated newly graduates to join us in 2027! 
 
 
Future Talent Programme is a Trainee Programme within Tetra Pak. We offer a permanent position from start in September 2027 at our site in Lund. You will onboard an individually designed development programme for 18 months connected to a specific position and the Tetra Pak organization. During the programme you will participate in trainings and job rotations throughout various parts of Tetra Pak to explore your potential and grow as a person. As a Trainee here with us, you will get to know our entire business and collaborate with colleagues all over the world. And this is just the beginning of your Tetra Pak career!
 
In Materials & Package we are responsible for the industrial lifecycle management and specification management for all packaging materials, packages, openings, closures & paper straws, secondary package and other additional materials for packaging solutions.
 
Visit https://www.tetrapak.com/about-tetra-pak/careers/future-talent and read more about Tetra Pak Future Talent Programme!
 
This position belongs to the Leadership Track.
 
You will be based in Lund, Sweden but you will work in a global arena.
What you will do
As our new Future Talent – Development Engineer Packaging Material you will:
 
Develop new innovative material solutions to meet our customer needs and our sustainability commitments
Work in a cross-functional scrum team where you will turn science into practice and drive the development of material from idea to market release
Design and evaluate the performance and functionality of the material, build knowledge, and participate in problem solving together with specialists and stakeholders
Coordinate test activities and work closely with laboratories, factories and specialists globally. You will work in the test facilities as well as working at your desk analysing data and writing reports and communicating results to stakeholders

We believe you have
You have a Masters Degree in Material Science or equivalent (Graduated 2026-2027)
It is possible that you have experience working with paperboard, polymers, packaging or recycling
You are fluent in English, written and spoken
You have good communications skills, written and spoken
Previous international studies/experience are considered meritorious

We Offer You
A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape
A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results
An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion
Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements

 
Apply Now
If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what's good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at https://jobs.tetrapak.com/. 
This job posting expires on 2026-12-08
To know more about the position contact Karin Olsson at +46 46 36 3124
Questions about your application contact Josephine Malalla at +46 46 36 5253
For trade union information, contact Akademikerklubben Lars Haraldsson at +46 46 36 2533 and Unionen Lisbeth Larsson at +46 46 36 2320
 
Diversity, equity, and inclusion is an everyday part of how we work. We give people a place to belong and support to thrive, an environment where everyone can be comfortable being themselves and has equal opportunities to grow and succeed. We embrace difference, celebrate people for who they are, and for the diversity they bring that helps us better understand and connect with our customers and communities worldwide.

Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions.  
Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future. 
Role Summary  
As a Project Coordinator, you will play a key role in supporting a large-scale People & Culture transformation project at Scania. You will work closely with the Program Manager to coordinate project activities, monitor progress, prepare management reporting, and ensure alignment across multiple workstreams. The role combines hands-on project coordination with exposure to program management, governance activities, and strategic decision-making. This is an opportunity to contribute to a major HR transformation while developing your project management expertise in a dynamic and cross-functional environment. 
Job Responsibilities
Support project planning, coordination, and follow-up activities across multiple workstreams. 
Collect, consolidate, and analyze project data, progress updates, and KPIs. 
Prepare reports, presentations, and decision-making materials for management and governance forums. 
Maintain project documentation, including project plans, risk registers, issue logs, and decision logs. 
Coordinate project meetings, workshops, and stakeholder forums. 
Monitor milestones, dependencies, risks, and deliverables together with business and IT stakeholders. 
Support HR systems implementation, enhancement, and decommissioning activities. 
Follow up on actions and help drive project activities forward. 
Contribute to continuous improvements in project governance, reporting, and ways of working. 

Who You Are
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. 
Minimum 3 years of experience in project coordination, project management, or a similar role. 
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. 
Strong analytical skills with the ability to structure, analyze, and present data. 
Experience preparing management presentations and project reporting materials. 
Strong communication skills and experience presenting to senior management. 
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. 
Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills. 
Fluent in English, both written and spoken. 

This Is Us
You will join a team driving the modernization of Scania's HR system landscape and People & Culture processes. Together with colleagues from HR, IT, Analytics, Process, Architecture, and Payroll, you will contribute to delivering sustainable improvements that simplify the employee experience and support Scania's strategic transformation journey. We value collaboration, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and a proactive approach to solving challenges. 
Scania Offers
We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions. 
With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally. 
Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje. 
Application
We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties. 
Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-12-01. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role. 
We look forward to your application!

jobs.occupation: Senior Business Analysts – Trading Compliance & Analytics
jobs.description:
We are looking for two Senior Business Analysts for a client undertaking a major transformation of its trade surveillance capabilities.
About the role
You will support the development of a next-generation surveillance platform used by international teams. Working at the intersection of business strategy and technology, you will take ownership of functional requirements and help guide their delivery from initial analysis through implementation.
The role involves translating complex business needs into actionable specifications, coordinating delivery activities, and ensuring data integrations meet relevant exchange requirements and technical standards.
Key responsibilities

Develop clear functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation for development, quality assurance, delivery, and surveillance teams.

Identify, document, prioritise, and validate data and functional requirements throughout the product lifecycle, balancing business value, exchange requirements, and technical feasibility.

Collaborate with surveillance teams across Europe and the US, alongside commercial and engineering stakeholders, to plan delivery, track requirements, resolve blockers, and maintain alignment with product design principles.

Work with Risk, Compliance, and Audit teams to review requirements, clarify expectations, and agree on enhancements and issue resolution.

Maintain the project backlog and establish governance procedures to support effective delivery.

Coordinate the calibration and tuning of surveillance models and detection patterns as they are introduced across asset classes, including equities and fixed income.

Support day-to-day surveillance activities, including reviews of business initiatives, market abuse risk assessments, and responses to user queries.

Required qualifications

A master’s degree in Economics, Finance, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

At least five years of experience as a business analyst or product analyst within capital markets, financial technology, or a regulated trading environment.

Strong knowledge of trading data structures, order management and execution workflows, trading protocols, and exchange rules.

An understanding of multiple asset classes and instruments, including equities, fixed income, futures, options, and forwards.

Demonstrated ability to turn complex business and technical requirements into structured documentation, such as functional specifications, user stories, and data flow diagrams.

Experience working in Agile delivery environments with cross-functional engineering and product teams, using tools such as Jira.

Strong analytical skills and advanced proficiency in SQL.

Preferred qualifications

Knowledge of trade surveillance, compliance monitoring, or regulatory frameworks such as MAR, MiFID II, FINRA requirements, and relevant market models or exchange rules.

Experience with large-scale data integration pipelines or market data feeds across multiple asset classes.

Familiarity with instrument reference data and how different traded products affect surveillance requirements.

Experience collaborating with international teams and stakeholders across regions.

Practical experience with trade surveillance platforms, including the calibration and tuning of detection models.

Extensive experience using Jira for backlog management and sprint planning.

Familiarity with data visualisation tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

Personal qualities
You work independently, take ownership of your responsibilities, and communicate clearly with both business and technical stakeholders.
Application & start date
Please submit your CV in English.
Start date: 7 December 2026 / ASAP End date: 31 December 2028 Application deadline: 20 November 2026 Hybrid work: Yes Location: Stockholm
Selections and interviews are ongoing!

jobs.occupation: Medical oncologist for an oncology department in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you a specialist in medical oncology looking for a role that combines professional development, multidisciplinary collaboration, and access to modern cancer treatments?
We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established oncology department in Sweden that provides comprehensive cancer care across a broad spectrum of diagnoses. You will join an experienced and supportive team where collaboration, clinical excellence and continuous development are highly valued.
This is an opportunity to work in a specialty that is constantly evolving, with access to modern therapies and the possibility to contribute to the ongoing development of cancer care while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.
About the role
As a specialist in oncology, you will be involved in:
Outpatient consultations and follow-up of oncology patients.
Systemic cancer treatments and individualized treatment planning.
Participation in multidisciplinary tumour conferences (MDTs).
Inpatient care as part of a rotating ward responsibility.
Collaboration with radiation oncology, palliative care and other specialties.
Supervision and mentoring of resident doctors.
Contributing to the continued development of clinical pathways and oncology services.

Depending on your experience and professional interests, there are opportunities to further develop specific areas of expertise within the department.
Why this opportunity?

Collaborative and supportive environment: 
Join an experienced oncology team known for its strong collegial atmosphere, close cooperation and willingness to support one another.

Modern oncology practice:
Work in a department that continuously follows developments in cancer treatment and offers access to innovative therapies and evidence-based care.

Professional development:
Benefit from ongoing opportunities for continuing medical education, subspecialization and participation in developing multidisciplinary tumour teams.

Varied clinical work:
Combine outpatient care, inpatient responsibilities, multidisciplinary collaboration and specialised oncology treatments within a broad clinical practice.

Long-term career opportunities:
Become part of a stable department with low staff turnover and a strong commitment to quality improvement and professional growth.

Life in central Sweden
The position is located in a scenic region of central Sweden, offering an excellent quality of life with forests, lakes and coastline within easy reach. The area combines a welcoming community atmosphere with modern infrastructure, short commuting times and access to outdoor activities throughout the year.
Families appreciate the safe environment, excellent schools and generous work-life balance, while larger cities and international travel connections remain easily accessible.
Requirements
EU-recognised specialist certification in Medical Oncology.
Solid clinical experience as a specialist in oncology.
Ability to work independently while contributing positively to a multidisciplinary team.
Interest in teaching, supervision and professional development.
Strong communication skills in English.
Motivation to learn Swedish through our language programme.

Why Choose Dignus Medical?
We are a trusted recruitment partner with over 20 years of experience helping medical professionals establish careers in Sweden. Our focus is on long-term success for both candidates and healthcare providers. From your first contact to your first day at work, we are with you every step of the way.

Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals, if required
Help with accommodation and relocation, including support for your family

Let’s talk! Contact us today to learn more about current openings or submit your application. We look forward to helping you take the next step in your internal medicine career.

jobs.occupation: Internship in Project and Production Engineering
jobs.description:
Company Description
Welcome to a world, where your ideas lead to something big. Welcome to Bosch!
Bosch Thermoteknik AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells heat pumps for the European market. We are approximately 650 employees and form part of the large Bosch Group, which consists of approximately 417,000 employees worldwide.
We work with sustainable simplification of everyday life where the focus is on the environment, innovation, and development. In Tranås there is a production unit and a competence and development center. The heat pumps we manufacture draw energy from different sources - the mountain, the water, or the air. We work to constantly be at the forefront and contribute to sustainable energy and a better environment with the goal of creating a simplified everyday life for our customers. In short, we create technology that is "Invented for life". 
Job Description
Your contribution to something big
As a full-time intern in the TEF4 department, you actively contribute to develop and create the conditions for a more efficient production setup to optimize manufacturing.
In this role you will be supporting the local Production Engineering department with daily project management tasks
You will have the opportunity to plan and execute your own production related projects
Evaluating data and creating statistics will allow you to follow up on KPIs of the production
Design parts and create drawings in CAD
Administrative tasks to support the local Production Engineering manager will also be part of your duties
You will be actively participating in the department’s improvement and development, e.g., by moderating workshops

Duration of the internship: 6 months preferably starting in February 2027
Location: on-site in our plant in Tranås, Sweden
Qualifications
What distinguishes you
Currently studying Industrial Engineering or similar (Bachelor or Master of Science)
Previous production-related experience desirable
Good analytical skills, problem-solving mindset, and technical thinking
You thrive in a dynamic work environment – identifying problems, finding solutions and executing them by actively driving your own ideas
Working knowledge in Microsoft Office tools (especially Excel, PowerPoint, Word); experience in other tools (CAD) is a plus
Knowledge in topics like IoT and Industry 4.0 could also be a plus
Open and communicative, ability to approach people easily and to work in a team environment
Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English, Swedish is an advantage

Additional Information
What we offer you
Monetary compensation is included to support you during your internship
We can offer free accommodation in Tranås
To support your well-being, we provide a wellness contribution for use on fitness, sports, or wellness services
We cover your travel costs from your residence to Tranås, making relocation easier for you
You gain valuable experience working within an international company with global connections

Welcome to Tranås – the heart of Bosch Home Comfort in Sweden
Tranås, beautifully located by the idyllic Lake Sommen and surrounded by forests and nature reserves, is home to Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Sweden. Here, more than 600 associates work in manufacturing and research & development of innovative heating solutions for a sustainable future.
At Bosch, we care about you, our business, and the environment.
We offer more than a job – we help you grow in your career and as a person. Life is about balance, and we support your goals, whether they involve new challenges, development, or time for family and hobbies.
Join a workplace that values individuality, openness, and trust, where you can be yourself and be inspired by diverse perspectives from around the globe.
Join us in Tranås and be part of shaping tomorrow’s energy solutions – in a workplace where innovation meets quality of life.
Here, you’ll find not just a job – but a lifestyle. #LikeABosch

jobs.occupation: Senior Automation Engineer at Metso in Kil!
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your career within automation and robotics? As an automation engineer at Metso, you will have the opportunity to work with international clients in exciting projects, develop innovative solutions, and collaborate with a dedicated team passionate about technology. We look forward to your application!
About the role
As a Senior Automation Engineer at Metso, you will join our EIA team (electrical, instrumentation, and automation) in Kil, which currently consists of about seven specialists. You will become a key player in developing, implementing, and optimizing the control systems and robotics solutions that drive our customers' automated processes worldwide.
The role involves end-to-end responsibility throughout the project lifecycle – from concept and design to machine testing in the workshop and final commissioning at the customer's site. Since we deliver globally, a central part of the position is that you enjoy traveling. Travel is a natural part of the job and can involve stays abroad for up to 8 weeks at a time during major start-ups. In the long term, and as you get settled into the role, we also envision that you can act as a mentor for younger colleagues in the team.
You are offered
Growth & Development: Clear learning pathways, mentoring, internal mobility, and opportunities for global collaboration
Compensation & Benefits: A competitive salary and a generous benefits package
An Inclusive Culture: An open workplace with supportive colleagues committed to helping each other thrive and succeed

Work tasks
Develop and adapt PLC programs, HMI solutions, and instrument configurations based on project-specific requirements and testing  
Perform machine testing in the workshop and handle commissioning at customer sites. Customer visits may range from short service trips lasting a few days to start-ups that can span several weeks over longer periods  
Create instructions, manuals, and training materials, as well as conduct training sessions for the customer’s technicians and operators  
Work with machine simulations and ensure that PLC programs and related systems are kept up to date  
Support other departments with automation-related information and technical assistance

We are looking for you who
Holds a post-secondary degree in automation or possesses equivalent work experience.
Has several years of experience in PLC programming, preferably in Siemens and/or Allen-Bradley environments.
Has excellent knowledge of English, both spoken and written.
Has the ability and willingness to travel internationally.
Holds a valid driver's license

It is meritorious if you have
Experience in robot programming.
Experience with Allen-Bradley Rockwell systems.
Experience with simulation tools such as Enterprise Dynamics, Visual Components, or similar.
Experience in automation R&D projects.

Working hours: 08:00–17:00
To succeed in this role, we believe you are structured, responsible, and detail-oriented. You enjoy leading others and communicate clearly both internally and with customers. You are solution-oriented and take initiative, with analytical skills that help improve processes and documentation. Additionally, you are flexible and confident working both independently and as part of a team.
The work is based in Kil or at Metso’s customer sites. If you are applying from another location, please describe in your application how you plan to commute to the workplace.
Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Do you want to combine qualified accounting with process development and ERP implementation in a fast-paced industrial environment? Do you thrive in a changing everyday setting where you can combine sharp attention to detail with a broader business perspective? Then this could be your next challenge!
About the position 
Perido is looking for a Senior Accountant on behalf of our client, an industrial enterprise driving large-scale initiatives within green energy and manufacturing. The position is located in Boden, with the possibility of working remotely two days a week.
Your daily tasks
The role is broad and includes both operational accounting and structural development work in close collaboration with various stakeholders across the organization. Your main responsibilities include:
Managing day-to-day accounting and month-end closing
Performing balance sheet and intercompany reconciliations
Handling VAT reporting
Managing CAPEX, fixed assets, and accounting classification
Contributing to the implementation of a new ERP system
Developing and documenting accounting processes and internal controls
Supporting audits and statutory reporting
Collaborating broadly with colleagues and stakeholders across the organization

Your characteristics
To thrive and succeed in this role, we are looking for someone who is structured, proactive, and solution-oriented. Since the assignment takes place in a fast-paced and changing environment, you are comfortable navigating change and can easily switch between seeing the bigger picture from a business perspective and ensuring high accuracy in the details. You are also communicative and find it easy to collaborate with different parts of the business.
Is this a challenge you want to take on? We look forward to reading your application—submit it today!
Qualifications:
At least 10 years of relevant experience in accounting, financial control, or a similar finance role
Strong knowledge of Swedish GAAP/K3
Hands-on experience with reconciliations, intercompany transactions, VAT, CAPEX, and fixed assets
Experience from an industrial environment, preferably within production, inventory, or logistics
Excellent spoken and written English

Meritorious:
Experience with ERP implementations, preferably in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud

Contract type and hours
Full-time, consulting assignment until 2028-01-04. Start 2027-01-05.
Application
Please apply through our website at perido.se/lediga-jobb/. Simply click the "Apply" button in the job advertisement, fill in your details, and upload your CV. We recommend submitting your application as soon as possible, as the selection process is ongoing. Please note that some details about the assignment and/or client company may have been deliberately disclosed in the advertisement. If your profile matches what the client is looking for and you are contacted by a recruiter, you will receive all the information you need.
You can find answers to most questions or concerns at perido.se/vanliga-fragor/. If you still haven't found the answer you are looking for, you are most welcome to contact us at fraga@perido.se and one of our Recruitment Communicators will answer you. Always enter the reference number 36129 in the subject line. Please note that we only accept applications through our website and that we are unable to provide updates on your application status.                  
About Perido
Why is our company named Perido? The name comes from the Latin word Peridoneus, which means 'well-matched'. Perido is a consulting and recruitment company specializing in the white-collar sector, dedicated to helping you take the next step in your career. Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. We have grown steadily since our founding in 2003 and now have over 1,500 employees across the country, including around fifty internal staff at our headquarters in Stockholm and Gothenburg. As a Perido consultant, you’ll play a key role in our organization, growing alongside us while strengthening our clients' businesses with your skills. Please visit our website www.perido.se for more information.

Process Developer – Finance, AI & Automation
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. 
 
 Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.
Role Summary
Are you passionate about AI, technology and transforming business processes?
We are looking for a proactive and analytical Process Developer to drive the transformation of Scania’s Finance processes, with a focus on Invoice-To-Pay (I2P) and the end-to-end Source-to-Pay (S2P) flow.
Our ambition is to create intelligent, AI-driven and increasingly touchless processes, minimizing manual work while improving efficiency, quality and compliance.
You will identify opportunities, challenge existing ways of working and drive improvements from idea to implementation. A key part of the role is understanding the entire S2P flow, including upstream activities within Procurement, to address root causes rather than simply automating existing problems.
You will work closely with Procurement, Finance, IT and other stakeholders, influencing decisions and driving change in a complex international environment. You will also contribute to Scania’s SAP S/4HANA transformation.
Job Responsibilities
Drive AI, automation and touchless process opportunities across Finance.
Analyze end-to-end S2P processes and identify upstream improvement opportunities.
Challenge existing processes and drive standardization and simplification.
Translate business needs into requirements and evaluate business value.
Influence stakeholders and drive cross-functional change initiatives.
Lead improvements from analysis to implementation and measurable results.

Who You Are
You are curious, analytical and driven by innovation and continuous improvement. You want to challenging established ways of working and turning ideas into results.
You have:
3–5 years of experience in process development, business transformation, automation, IT or a related field.
A degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering and Management, IT, Business or Finance.
Strong analytical skills and an end-to-end process mindset.
A genuine interest in AI, digitalization and intelligent automation.
Strong stakeholder management, communication and change-driving skills.
The ability to work independently and navigate a complex organization.
Fluent in Swedish and English.

Experience with S2P, Procurement, Accounts Payable, SAP S/4HANA, AI or automation technologies is an advantage.
This Is Us
We develop and improve Scania’s financial processes across Europe, China and Scania Latin America.
You will join an international team where process expertise, technology and innovation come together to shape the future of Finance.
 
Scania Offers 
 
We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.
With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.
Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.
 
Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-11-27. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.
 
 If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: 
Magda Blosinska, Talent Acquisition Specialist: magda.blosinska@scania.com

Do you enjoy product development and want to be involved in the creation from sketch to finished product? Now you have the chance to become an important part of our mechanics group and help us shape future products. In this role, you have good opportunities to be part of and influence our development journey! We are now looking for a Mechanical Lead Engineer for our Multi Channel Products team at our HQ in Lund, Sweden.
 
Your future team
We're a team of 25 passionate mechanical engineers of all ages and backgrounds who share a love for technology and solving complex challenges. We place a strong emphasis on creativity, collaboration, and openness. You'll find yourself surrounded by supportive colleagues who are always eager to help and contribute to your growth. We have a fantastic collaboration and team spirit. As an employee of the MCP (Multi Channel Products) mechanics group, you will participate actively in projects with different challenges and focuses. We often develop completely new products with innovation possibilities. At MCP, we develop Multidirectional cameras, Panoramic cameras, and Modular cameras.
 
What you'll do here as a Mechanical Lead Engineer
As Lead Engineer for our mechanics team, you will play a key role in structuring and driving the mechanical development process in your product project. Together with the project manager, you will plan and coordinate activities, ensuring that priorities, schedules, and resources are aligned. You will guide the mechanical engineers, build efficient ways of working, and secure smooth collaboration with other disciplines and global suppliers. While much of your focus will be on creating clarity, structure, and teamwork, you will also stay closely involved in the technical development - contributing your expertise and curiosity to shape smart, reliable, and innovative mechanical solutions.
 
As you will have significant responsibility for developing new products, often taking them from the initial concept stage through to the finished product, you will also work closely with the implementation of the product in volume production. In this phase, you will collaborate with quality engineers, production technicians, suppliers, and other stakeholders.
 
Who are you?
We're looking for a passionate and hands-on product development engineer to lead the mechanical development of our next-generation Multi Channel products. You are someone who thrives on solving complex engineering challenges while inspiring others to do their best work.
 
You bring structure, clear communication, and an easygoing, collaborative approach. You lead by example, staying close to the technical details while guiding your team forward.
 
We believe you hold a degree in Mechanical Engineering and have at least 5 years of experience in mechanical design and product development. Experience with die-casting, injection molding, production, mechanical and environmental testing is highly valued. Proficiency in 3D CAD and fluency in English, both written and spoken, are essential.
 
What Axis has to offer
We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. 
Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide. 
As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance. 
 
Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance - and even your own Axis bicycle.

Axis Career Hub

Engineering at Axis blog 
Innovation at Axis 
 
Ready to act?
Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications.
We go through applications continuously so don't wait - send in your application today!

Are you a individual who values team spirit over self-interest and also happens to be a Linux expert? Do you want to broaden your technical expertise and make a difference in brand protection? Then the role as Linux System Engineer at Abion could be the perfect fit for you!
About Abion
“Abion is a fast-growing and profitable platform-based IP and domain services provider on a journey on becoming a European IP powerhouse. We have a unique position in the market with nearly 30 years of experience in digitalization as an ICANN-accredited registrar and a comprehensive Brand Protection package and software and services within Domain Management, Trademark Management, and Web Security.
We offer an exciting position in a fast-paced organization that is constantly growing and developing in a highly current industry. At Abion, we believe in giving our employees great freedom with responsibility. We foster a diverse, dynamic, and permissive culture with lots of cross-departmental collaboration and with great opportunities for personal development. We want to be the best and therefore expect the best from ourselves and our colleagues.
Abion is on an exciting path, and we want like-minded people to join us on the next step of our journey to become the best IP company in Europe, an IP powerhouse!”
About the position
As a Linux System Engineer at Abion, you will take on a multifaceted role with a focus on Linux administration in hosting, server management, and web support on Linux platforms. This role heavily involves 3rd-line support, handling escalated cases directed to the Linux team or submitted via email.
